verdict.rationale: Hatchet's own repo claims built-in real-time monitoring and alerting, and its docs have an OpenTelemetry page, which points to export into external observability stacks. However, the pack contains only that page title, with no detail on what is exported or how alerts are configured. missing for 10: documented export of failure-rate, latency and queue-depth metrics (e.g. Prometheus/OTel metrics), documented alert rules/destinations for misbehaving workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, failure rates, latencies, and queue depths export to my observability stack, and alerts fire when workflows misbehave

citations.quote: Hatchet provides a full platform for queuing, automatic retries, durability, real-time monitoring, alerting, and logging.
